name: Junior Software Developer
description:
Pebble Analytics is a product-analytics tool for small mobile-game studios. Studios drop in our SDK and get retention, funnel and revenue dashboards without hiring a data team. We are a remote team of 11, and we publish the salary range for every role we open.

What you'll do

  • Build dashboard features in React and TypeScript.
  • Extend our Node.js ingestion API and the jobs that roll up events into daily metrics.
  • Write SQL against PostgreSQL and ClickHouse and make slow queries fast.
  • Help studios debug their SDK integration.

Requirements

  • 1+ year of professional experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience building web APIs (Node.js preferred).
  • Good SQL skills.

Nice to have

  • Python for data scripts.
  • ClickHouse or another column store.
  • You play mobile games and have opinions about their onboarding.

Compensation

USD 28,000-35,000 per year, fully remote within EMEA and South Asia. Flexible hours with a daily overlap window of 11:00-15:00 UTC.
